notes.title: v1.1.3 - Minor improvement + Various Fixes
notes.content:
Hello crawlers, here's the v1.1.3 changelog!

Gameplay:
- In the inventory GUI, pressing Drop key ([E] by default) let you drop the gear of the slot you are pointing at, or the gear you "picked up"  by left-clicking.
- Now the minimap shows Anvil, Altar, and Fountain.

Bugfix:
- Fixed the case where dropping items while no open space was allowed, causing the item to disappear.
- Items no longer drop at the place occupied by indestructible objects, such as Anvil.
- If you get an item from a fountain while inventory is full, the item is dropped on the floor rather than destroyed.
- Fixed the Game log stating the wrong item name when your item was turned into cheese.
- Changed terrain of several floors of the 3rd dungeon. Some of them were impossible for the shops to spawn.

notes.title: v1.1.2 - Bugfix
notes.content:
- Fixed the bug when using Scroll of Escape on the floor caused the game to freeze.
- Fixed Upgrade GUI not correctly displaying upgradable nodes in some cases.

notes.title: v1.1.1 Small Update
notes.content:
Hello, Crawlers! Here's a small fix.

-Warrior's Armor now has a missing modifier: Offensive.
-Skill GUI now has the "X" button at the upper right corner to close with mouse click.

notes.title: v1.1.0 Update - Gear Improvement Tweak
notes.content:
Hello crawlers!

Magic Alter's "Random Mod" option now gives you 3 modifier choices to add, instead of getting a totally random one. I thought there should be a little more room for the player's decisions.

Improving weapons has been more impactful than improving armors in most situations. So, the cost of armor improvement on the anvil/altar is reduced to balance things off. (-30%)

Good luck with your next run!

notes.title: v1.0.1 Update - Skill GUI
notes.content:
Hello, this is a small update thanks to the feedback.

Previously, after you level up you could only see the skills you can acquire.

After this update, the GUI will display the entire skill list, so you can anticipate and plan the future build! You can also press the Skill button (default 'K') to see the list anytime!
